_help: Empty cost-and-pricing template. Delete the keys that start with _ if you want; the script ignores them. Net amounts, without value added tax. Spanish keys (compras, tipos_de_cambio, precio_unit, factor_unidad, recargo, equilibrio, supuestos...) are still accepted.
_profile: Profile name (looks for <name>.yaml in METHODIC_DATA and ../methodic-data, profiles/ then perfiles/; the legacy INGENIERO_DATOS and ../ingeniero-agentico-datos are still read) or a path. Empty = the only profile found there, or the repo template, and then everything taken from it is an assumption. --profile on the command line overrides this field.
_global_markup: Markup ON COST for items without their own: 0.30 = cost × 1.30. null = the profile's (pricing.default_markup).
_overhead: Share of direct cost charged as indirect cost: 0.08 = 8 %. null = the profile's; if the profile has none either, 0 % marked as an assumption.
_min_margin_alert: Optional: warns if an item's real margin falls below this share.
_exchange_rates: One per foreign currency that appears in purchases. Without a declared exchange rate the script stops: it does not invent one.
_items: What is sold. quantity_sold in the sale unit (if missing, = what was bought). An item's own markup overrides the global one. manual_price overrides everything and the real markup is recomputed. If you leave out items, one is created per «item» in purchases.
_purchases: One row per purchase order line or awarded quote line, in the supplier's unit and currency. item = which sale item it is charged to. unit_factor = sale units per supplier unit (6 m length sold by the metre = 6). Empty currency = the profile's.
_breakeven: Optional. Contribution margin and break-even of a service or product, with fixed costs of the same period. With units produced and sold, it compares variable and absorption costing (no opening inventory).
_assumptions: Assumptions you make yourself, carried to the output with origin `input`: a text, or {"parameter": "", "value": null, "source": ""}.
